errors.text: No quantitative prediction relative to unmodified CoCrFeNiTi is provided.
The Nb concentration and processing window are unspecified, making the intervention irreproducible.
The cited evidence reports that increasing hard Laves-phase content decreases plasticity, directly undermining the claim that favorable plasticity and machinability will be preserved.
Evidence is drawn mainly from CoCrFeNi, AlCoCrFeNi, and coating systems rather than the Ti-containing CoCrFeNiTi composition.
